about: Targets for the registry-default decision_agent / action_agent (v5: in-meeting memory plus feedback guidance) on meeting_memory_golden.json: the share of cases whose emitted cards (after memory.reconcile) match the expected outcome. First live run 2026-11-11 (24 calls): accuracy 1.0 on 12 cases; min_accuracy stays 0.75 to absorb model variance.
